mutants.name: reporter-paid-on-fallback
mutants.from: if(reporter!=tx.origin) revert BadCalldata(); // V3-17: no reporter on a fallback block

mutants.name: late-last-share-reverts
mutants.from: if(((w>>88)&LOW64)<uint256(j)) put(r,(w&~LAST_MASK)|(uint256(j)<<88)); // V3-02 lastShare = max(lastShare, j)

mutants.name: late-last-share-overwrites
mutants.from: if(((w>>88)&LOW64)<uint256(j)) put(r,(w&~LAST_MASK)|(uint256(j)<<88)); // V3-02 lastShare = max(lastShare, j)

mutants.name: base-burn-still-burned
mutants.from: if(r!=a){ if(get(1)!=0) burned+=r-a; else {uint256 k=carrySlot(block.number+1); put(k,get(k)+(r-a));} } // V3-15

mutants.name: carry-kept-at-final
mutants.to: uint256 f=get(carrySlot(h)); if(f!=0) put(carrySlot(h),0); put(0,get(0)+tips+f); put(1,h);

mutants.name: base-burn-into-closed-pot
mutants.from: if(r!=a){ if(get(1)!=0) burned+=r-a; else {uint256 k=carrySlot(block.number+1); put(k,get(k)+(r-a));} } // V3-15
mutants.to: if(r!=a){ if(get(1)!=0) burned+=r-a; else {uint256 x=(r-a)/2; uint256 n=base(j+1); put(n,get(n)+x); put(carrySlot(block.number+1),get(carrySlot(block.number+1))+(r-a)-x);} }

mutants.name: lagged-carry-kept-at-final
mutants.to: uint256 f=get(carrySlot(h+1)); if(f!=0) put(carrySlot(h+1),0); put(0,get(0)+tips+f); put(1,h);
